required_stages.description: Allocate a fresh (batch, out_channels, out_L) output of input's dtype inside run(); no zero-fill needed.

One logical pass with no global-memory intermediate (no im2col, padded copy or split-K partials; the output tiles may be spread over several launches): per group, output viewed as (batch*out_L) x Cout_g, reduction over the flattened (ic_local, kl) axis gathered on the fly with zero fill, tensor-core product into a local fp32 accumulator, cast and masked/clipped store.

forbidden_substitutions.message: A library convolution replaces the whole computation.
A library GEMM (on an im2col matrix or otherwise) replaces the core computation.
Materialised im2col/unfold is forbidden; the convolution must be an implicit GEMM.
A padded or zero-filled copy of the input is forbidden; zero padding must be realised by masking inside the kernel.
Atomic accumulation suggests split-K, which is a different reduction structure.
Possible downcast of fp32 operands below TF32 precision.
Cross-call caching of input-derived data is forbidden.

required_evidence.message: No matrix-multiply primitive found; the implicit GEMM must use a tensor-core product.

outputs.aliasing: none; the returned (batch, out_channels, out_L) tensor must be freshly allocated inside run() and must not share storage with input or weight

timing_boundary.notes: The GPU time of all device work launched by run() is counted (here only the implicit-GEMM kernel launch(es)); host-side scalar metadata, the output allocation call and zero-copy views are not GPU time. No cast, transpose, pack, padded copy or im2col of the inputs; no cached state across calls.
